result:
PR #399 is marked ready for review. It's pushed at `08ad953514` with `origin/master` merged in, and its `Files:` line matches the diff.

**Why the first attempt didn't finish:** it ended at 07:42 PDT waiting on the 29 pass-1 device runs, which was the right place to stop. After that the Nova went down, and at 12:02 PDT the owner stopped pass 1. `NOTES.md` now records all of this, including the owner's new rule that a device batch over 30 minutes needs a reviewed pilot run first.

**This session:** I looked at every frame of the 17 finished runs. I counted a title as reaching gameplay only if every frame from the start of the scored window onward shows a player-controlled scene. No title meets the owner's Playable bar.

- **Reached gameplay, below 30 fps:** 25 to Life (median 35.7 fps, but only 54% of play at 30+), Blinx 2 (21.7), Crimson Skies (23.4; its last 2 minutes drop to 2–8 fps).
- **Reached gameplay, under 20 fps** (the owner's rule for a separate issue):
  - Agent Under Fire: 16.2 fps, filed as **#412**.
  - DOA Ultimate: 12.6 fps, and a stage transition stalls for up to 76 s. Filed as **#413**.
  - Forza: 16.7 fps, and the race clock runs at 26% of real time. Filed as **#414**.
  - Blinx: 14.8 fps, added as a comment on **#372**.
- **Call of Duty 3:** reached gameplay only in the last ~60 s, so it isn't measured.
- **Not reached (8):** 50 Cent and Black (stuck on the profile keyboard), Bruce Lee (Player Info screen), Burnout Revenge (profile loop), Burnout 3 (profile prompt, then the Race Training videos), DOA3 (copyright warning, then the title screen), DOA Xtreme (shop menu), Galleon (about 3 minutes of loading, then a scene I couldn't confirm was gameplay).
- **Fuzion Frenzy didn't run:** after the host moved it to the Thor, the request still pointed at the Nova's file path.

The full table is posted on #397. `NOTES.md` also says what a scripted route would need to get each unreached title past its blocker, as input for however the owner decides to reach gameplay next.

**Preflight:** every step passes except `coverage`. It fails only because #412–#414 are new issues the board hasn't classified yet, and lanes may not edit the board files. It will clear once the board picks them up.

I queued no new device runs, and the 12 parked requests are untouched.
